name: Bold Ad
tagline: Neelshah's Bold preset: black, white, signal red and warning yellow, Archivo caps slamming every beat at 128 BPM.

motion.direction: Neelshah `Bold` social ad. 128 BPM: enter 0.32 s / stagger 0.035 / exit 0.20; Archivo Black caps at 190 px with −0.03 em tracking; word slams on every beat, hard cuts, COLOUR FLIPS (use `card` mode's dark plate vs `full`) between sections. Spine: 0–1 s something moves in frame 1 (no logo, no fade from black) → problem / promise in big type cut on the beat → proof with karaoke captions (54–64 px) → 2–3 single-word slams with flips → CTA. Red `ter` is the accent, yellow `gold` the warning / highlight, green `goldd` only for OK. ≤ 3 flashes per second; no system fonts, no hype words.
